The lineup

Five games, five kinds of pressure

From split-second taps to slow-burn puzzles to full-speed runners — every game in Gaming Zone trains a different instinct.

01 — REACTION

Number Tapping

A fast-paced reaction game designed to test hand-eye coordination under pressure.

How it plays

Pick a target number, then find it inside a shuffled 3×3 grid before time runs out. Every correct tap shrinks your window — from a relaxed 15 seconds down to a single second — until one wrong tap or a missed window ends the run.

  • Fast-paced tapping gameplay
  • Increasing difficulty with faster spawns
  • Score tracking and high-score system
  • Simple one-tap controls
  • Built to sharpen reaction time
02 — PUZZLE

Number Quest

A brain-training puzzle that challenges your focus, quick thinking and pattern recognition.

How it plays

A 3×3 grid shuffles the numbers 1 through 9. Tap them in ascending order before a strict 10-second timer runs out — clear the grid and a fresh one appears, timer reset. One wrong tap or a missed deadline is game over.

  • Number sequences and logic challenges
  • Progressive difficulty each stage
  • Rewards and unlockable levels
  • Educational yet entertaining
  • Trains problem-solving under time pressure
03 — ENDLESS RUNNER

Glow Runner

A side-scrolling endless runner built to test your reflexes and timing against a neon skyline.

How it plays

Your character runs forward automatically — tap to jump obstacles as the pace keeps climbing. Collect glowing orbs along the way, and survive as long as you can. A new high score triggers a confetti celebration.

  • Neon graphics and glowing animations
  • Endless running with escalating speed
  • Jump-and-dodge obstacle mechanics
  • Collectible glowing orbs for bonus points
  • An addictive high-score chase
04 — 3D RUNNER

Neon Velocity 3D

A pseudo-3D endless runner delivering a full synthwave, high-speed experience — no external 3D engine required.

How it plays

Swipe or use the on-screen controls to move left, move right, jump and duck down a curving perspective road. Matrix-based transforms, speed lines and camera shake sell the depth, while obstacles and pace both scale up the longer you survive.

  • Continuous forward movement, simple controls
  • Randomized obstacles for replayability
  • Item collection for score boosts
  • Increasing speed and difficulty over time
  • High score leaderboard system
05 — ARCADE

Brick Dash

A classic, physics-based brick breaker set in a deep-space cosmic scene, built on the Flame engine.

How it plays

Keep your paddle under a bouncing ball and dash through rows of bricks before they reach the bottom. Smooth Flame-powered physics drive every collision, with power-ups and special balls to work into your runs.

  • Classic brick-breaker mechanics, modern design
  • Multiple levels with unique brick patterns
  • Power-ups and special balls
  • Fast-reflex gameplay against falling bricks
  • Score and level progression tracking
